body: @sshev Which releases are impacted by this bug? Has this made into 2.4 by any chance?
@chirag-yb  No this was not backported so it is not in 2.4

@sshev This issue was due to null currentPlacementStatus prop. Earlier we were not getting the AZ info on the initial load it was only coming if you refresh the page or make any changes which result to call the cluster_resources and cluster_configure API's and thus setting the above prop to a valid data.

issue.title: [Platform] Changing AZ node counts is not handled correctly in "Edit Universe"

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
1. Increase Node count in AZ a
2. Decrease it back to original number in AZ a
3. Increase node count in AZ c

What is expected is 1 node to be added in AZ c and the AZ a node count remains the same.

YW seems to create an intent for an extra node for AZ a also, but it doesn't look like its actually gonna provision a new node.
This was seen on 2.2.3.0-b30. 2.1.11 did not show this issue
